sv.title: Tåg stoppades efter misstänkt hot – 120 resenärer saknades
sv.summary: Ett tåg mellan Stockholm och Göteborg stoppades av polisen efter uppgifter om ett misstänkt brott. Enligt Expressens uppgifter hade 120 resor bokats med snarlika, hotfulla mejladresser – men ingen av de bokade resenärerna fanns ombord.

en.title: Train stopped after suspected threat – 120 passengers unaccounted for
en.summary: A train between Stockholm and Göteborg was stopped by police following information about a suspected crime. According to Expressen, 120 trips had been booked with similar, threatening email addresses – but none of the booked passengers were on board.
